digest.component_or_area: inbound fetcher and project store reconciler
propositions: Inbound fetcher processes only one tracker project even when store mapping lists multiple projects, causing parent/comment/issuelink enrichment data to be silently dropped for all but one project
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project, leaving bridge_project and repos fields unset
Fan-out implementation must execute JQL pair and all three enrichment passes once per configured project, merging results into shared snapshot deduplicated by seen_keys
Per-query truncation ceiling must remain scoped per project to prevent one busy project from exhausting shared budget
Source project derivation and repos mapping must be recorded at CREATE write site via helper that extracts project prefix from jira key
